name: Takuzu
author: qempexe
description: Takuzu (binary puzzle) for the Omarchy bar: keyboard-driven popup with three difficulties, logical hints, timer and saved progress.

schema.label: Show row and column needs
schema.description: Under the board, say how many 0s and 1s the selected row and column still need.

schema.label: Highlight errors
schema.description: Tint cells that break a rule and mark entries that do not match the solution.

schema.label: Mistake limit
schema.description: The puzzle is lost after this many wrong entries. 0 means unlimited.

schema.label: Show the timer on the bar
schema.description: Show the elapsed time next to 01 while a puzzle is in progress.
